'''Davidge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who became the [[Minister of Logistics]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] at the start of the [[Galactic War]]; he had extensive dealings with [[Dark Council]]or, [[Darth Marr]].
